name: instant-provisioner — customer-data drop errors (backend Deprovision failing through the chokepoint, infra leaking)
description: P2 observability/recoverable. instant_provisioner_drop_total{outcome='error'} > 0 sustained >30m, faceted by resource_type + backend. A backend Deprovision is failing through server.guardedDrop: the customer-data destruction did not complete, so the backing infra (DB / role / cache / queue) is leaking unreclaimed (a slow capacity + cost leak). A single blip self-heals when the caller (TTL reaper / team-deletion / user DELETE) retries; a sustained rate means a backend is wedged. Walk the resource_type / backend labels to the targeted backend's /healthz and the provisioner circuit-breaker state. Source: provisioner/internal/server/drop_chokepoint.go.

nrql.query: SELECT sum(instant_provisioner_drop_total) FROM Metric WHERE metricName = 'instant_provisioner_drop_total' AND outcome = 'error' FACET resource_type, backend
